lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters (spots) are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. A distinct triad of spots is located at the anterior-most region of the visible lateral flank, forming an obtuse triangular arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs in the post-gill region, creating a discernible but low-contrast grid-like distribution.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal gradient vector is visible running across the dorsal aspect of the gill slits, characterized by a high-intensity upper edge and a lower shadow-cast region.

other_distinctive_markers: A smaller fusiform organism with a distinct dark lateral stripe is present in the lower-central quadrant, ventral to the shark's head.
